Maya (CEO): Quick Friday briefing 3 items and 2 asks.
Maya (CEO): 1) EU LAUNCH: target Wed 08:00 UTC. Legal/OPS please confirm DPA + checklist by Mon COB.
Maya (CEO): 2) Retention change: default hosted logs -> 90d; enterprise opt-in 365d. Nina to publish short FAQ.
Maya (CEO): 3) Incident note: brief memory leak in inference pool yesterday caused ~15m elevated p99; auto-scale mitigated. Postmortem incoming.
Maya (CEO): Metrics: hosted p95 ~115ms, error 0.6% (close).
Maya (CEO): Asks: (A) Comms: one-paragraph customer note for EU + retention by Tue 10:00. (B) Eng/SRE: prioritize patch for pool memory leak.

Ethan (VP Eng): Ack. Scaling patch in review; will hold non-critical console merges until EU goes live.

Sam (SRE): Memory leak repro steps and temp mitigation:
```
# quick mitigation
kubectl cordon node-7
kubectl drain node-7 --ignore-daemonsets
systemctl restart infer-agent
```
Applying permanent fix next deploy.

Nina (Head Legal): I'll put the retention FAQ up and confirm DPA items.

Lara (Product): I'll draft the customer note and UI wording; sending PR by Mon morning.

Owen (Finance): I'll model cost impact for EU GA and share numbers by Tue EOD. Need expected usage forecast from Product.

notify-bot: deploy queued for `eu-rollout` (commit ff9a2) by @Ethan 3 ETA 28m.

Maya (CEO): Thanks team. I'll call this out in Monday all-hands. Ping me directly if anything blocks sign-off. :rocket:
